summary: Siem Reap, Cambodia, former CTO of an adserving platform, experience in online advertising and video analytics, strong interest in Haskell and functional programming, familiarity with QuickCheck and type systems, engaged in technical contract work, has lived in Southeast Asia for several years, has a background in building and exiting SaaS businesses, advocates for online privacy and compliance with data protection laws, has a nuanced understanding of EU regulations, enjoys discussing programming languages and their ecosystems, has a critical view of corporate practices in tech, and has a personal connection to the hacker community.
